children: Two London-based M&A partners from Weil, ​Gotshal & Manges are joining rival law firm Sullivan & Cromwell in the latest exit of prominent dealmakers from New York-based Weil.

Sullivan & Cromwell said on Thursday that David Avery-Gee, Weil's London M&A leader and co-managing partner of its London office, is joining the firm alongside partner Sarah Flaherty. Avery-Gee will co-lead Sullivan & Cromwell's European M&A practice.

Avery-Gee was not immediately available for comment. His clients have included Advent International, Eli Lilly, Sanofi and Willis Towers Watson, according to his biography on Weil's website. Avery-Gee and Flaherty previously worked at Linklaters before joining Weil in 2020 and 2023, respectively.
A Weil spokesperson did not immediately comment.

The moves come a week after Cravath, Swaine & Moore said it had hired leading New York dealmaker Michael Aiello, who led Weil's corporate department, alongside five other partners including Weil's M&A practice co-leader Matthew ​Gilroy.

Weil on Wednesday announced that Kyle Krpata, based in California, and Michael Lubowitz, based in New York, will lead its corporate department effective immediately. "The deal market is evolving, and Weil is investing to meet that shift head-on," the firm said.

Sullivan & Cromwell said the additions boost its global M&A capabilities. The New York firm has made a string of U.S. partner hires in recent weeks, including a group of private equity partners from Kirkland & Ellis, and former top Fox Corp lawyer Viet Dinh. The firm also announced this week that it is opening an office in Abu Dhabi.
